patch_description: Replace part of the purely Gaussian start population with structured but non-rigid cube-and-axis starts. The cube vertices plus six axial points provide a useful high-contact geometric scaffold for a 14-point diameter packing, while independent radial factors, axial offsets, and non-antipodal noise avoid locking the search into the inferior symmetric cube-axis family. These starts retain the same total number of relaxation runs, so they improve basin coverage without increasing the dominant optimization cost.
